Phone saves and exports (Android / iPhone)

Save stores the invoice in the CRM on this device. If portable HTML saving is enabled, an updated HTML copy is also downloaded. Use Share HTML to save it in Files or send it to another device.

Offline editing works when the HTML runs in a full browser. Native sharing depends on browser support.

iPhone: use Safari’s print/share controls to save a PDF to Files. Android: choose Save as PDF in the print destination. Files Quick Look may not run the editor; open it in a full browser. The source HTML cannot silently overwrite itself.
